h1: Chitwan National Park Jungle Safari & Tharu Cultural Tour
metaDesc: Discover Nepal's rich wildlife in Chitwan National Park with deep jungle jeep safaris, river canoeing, and Tharu tribal traditions.
Thrilling mountain biking tour around Kathmandu Valley rim. Ride through Tokha, Mudkhu, Shivapuri forest single-tracks, and traditional Newari farming villages.

h1: Best of Nepal: Kathmandu, Pokhara & Chitwan Wildlife Tour
metaDesc: The ultimate 8-day Nepal experience combining Kathmandu valley heritage, Pokhara lake views, and Chitwan subtropical jungle safari.

metaDesc: Witness panoramic Himalayan views stretching from Annapurna to Mt. Everest from Nagarkot ridge, combined with Bhaktapur pottery heritage.
